title: step-a0c-sweep PROP-070 may auto-close ISSes whose created_at post-dates parent EXP integrated_at
description: Two minor ISSes (ISS-2417 INTERMAGNET/FSF labels, ISS-2416 monitor.py-outlier steel-man) were created 2026-05-31T21:09:26Z as curmudgeon c2 follow-up holes against §8b.3 L3a, AFTER parent EXP-462 was integrated at 2026-05-31T17:08:44Z. Decider step-a0c-sweep PROP-070 (run decider-2026-06-02T09-04) auto-closed both at 2026-06-02T09:19:46Z with fixed_by=exp-integrated and closure_evidence.exp_id=EXP-462, treating them as residual holes of EXP-462 rather than gap-followups that post-date its integration. Operationally low-risk here (substantive coverage preserved via cross-references; ISSes were minor; analyst tracker entries marked complete in same run). Structural risk: a non-trivial curmudgeon-c2-style hole found after parent EXP integration could be silently dismissed in future. Recommend tinker audit the step-a0c-sweep firing condition for an ordering check (iss.created_at < exp.integrated_at).
proposed_test: For each closed-issues.json entry with fixed_by=exp-integrated since PROP-070 deployment, compare iss.created_at vs closure_evidence.exp_integrated_at. Flag and report any where iss.created_at > exp.integrated_at.
